sources.citation: Harvey, Mark. 2008. Proto Mirndi: a discontinuous language family in northern Australia. Pacific Linguistics 593. Canberra: ANU (hdl 1885/146746).
sources.note: Nothing on Dagoman stress. p.3: 'This dialect relationship also includes a third variety — Dagoman. There are very limited materials on Dagoman, and slightly more extensive materials on Yangman.'
